column1: In this case, the problem that arises is moral hazard, the risk that an imperfectly monitored agent will act in a dishonest or otherwise inappropriate way. In particular, entrepreneurs investing other people’s money may not look after the investment projects as carefully as those who invest their own money. Once Patti has Larry’s money in hand, she may be tempted to choose the easy life. If she succumbs to moral hazard, she will reduce the future profitability of the firm and increase the risk of default on her firm’s debts.
